entry_points.summary: Wraps one killable external command in a hard deadline. Resolves timeout backend via check-timeout.sh (timeout/gtimeout preferred; bash fallback zero-dep). Emits dispatch_start + dispatch_end lease events to events.jsonl. On deadline: kills process group (SIGTERM then SIGKILL after grace), returns exit 124. Diagnostics go to stderr only; child stdout passes through byte-for-byte.

Daemonized poller (setsid nohup ... & disown) spawned at run start. Polls events.jsonl for dispatch_start with no matching dispatch_end past deadline_ts; calls liveness.sh for unmatched subagent *_start past stale_secs. On stall: emits watchdog_stall and (if intervention_level=notify) calls notify-watchdog.sh. Self-exits when run record gone, watchdog.enabled=false, or max_lifetime_secs exceeded.

Out-of-band human alert. Gates on config.py should-notify --event <event>. Channels (best-effort): Discord webhook (curl -fsS -m 10) if notify.discord_webhook_url set; macOS osascript desktop notification as fallback. Message includes run, stuck dispatch/phase, age, and actionable kill <pid> line when pid known. Never fails caller.

Atomic single-spawn guard for the sweep. Uses flock on $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR/active/<run>.watchdog.pid: if file holds a live pid, skip spawn; else spawn, write pid, release. Called by z-execute and z-overnight at run start.

Detects available timeout binary (timeout/gtimeout/none). Existing $TIMEOUT_CMD detection unchanged; added sourceable timeout_backend() predicate that echoes timeout|gtimeout|bash_fallback. Shared by supervised-run.sh and watchdog-sweep.sh (DRY).

invariants: CAPABILITY BOUNDARY (load-bearing): killable subprocesses are genuinely killed and recovered; native Agent() stalls can only be detected and alerted — never auto-recovered from shell
dispatch_id is mandatory in all lease events; sweep matches start<->end strictly by dispatch_id, never by type or pid
supervised-run.sh writes all own diagnostics to stderr only; child stdout passes through byte-for-byte (non-regression for reviewer $(…) capture)
Exit code 124 iff this wrapper enforced the deadline; 128+signum if killed by a signal sent by the wrapper; otherwise passthrough
Telemetry is fail-open: if log-event.sh fails, the wrapped command still runs and is still deadline-enforced
The sweep never SIGKILLs on a stale *_start heuristic — only the enforcement wrapper kills, on a deterministic deadline
Sweep is idempotent per stall (notify-once dedup via marker file); a crash of the sweep must not affect the orchestrator
watchdog.enabled is re-read from config on every sweep iteration (live kill-switch); Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED is read at spawn time only
watchdog.timeout_secs.* per-type table is config-file-only — NOT exported as env vars; read via config.py get watchdog.timeout_secs.<type>
gotchas: macOS lacks a system timeout(1); supervised-run.sh falls back to a bash deadline that works but emits a one-time timeout_degraded event per run; install coreutils (brew install coreutils) for gtimeout
Remote confined cargo (remote-confined-run.sh via systemd-run --user) is best-effort kill only: killing local ssh does not stop the remote unit; alert includes cleanup hint but no auto-cleanup in v1
watchdog-sweep.sh MUST be daemonized (setsid nohup ... </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & disown); a plain & inherits the tool's stdout fd and prevents the Bash tool from returning
The pid file $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR/active/<run>.watchdog.pid is authoritative for spawn dedup; the registry watchdog_pid field is advisory/observability only
liveness.sh intentionally excludes phase/run/light_run/user_wait lifecycle brackets — it catches subagent stalls, not phase stalls
Notify-once dedup key is dispatch_id for dispatch stalls, <base>-<tid> for liveness stalls — a genuinely new stall still alerts but re-detections of the same stall do not respam
notify-watchdog.sh fires notify-watchdog.sh in background (& from sweep) so a slow Discord curl never stalls the poll loop
A typo'd env var like Z_HARNESS_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_SECS is silently ignored; only config.py get watchdog.timeout_secs.<type> is authoritative

event_vocabulary.description: Emitted before the wrapped command is launched; forms the open half of the lease pair
Emitted after the wrapped command exits (normally or killed); closes the lease pair
Emitted when the enforcement wrapper fires the deadline kill; remote_orphan_possible:true for cargo/remote dispatches
Emitted by the sweep when a confirmed stall is detected; triggers out-of-band alert at intervention_level=notify
Emitted when a self-guarded read of events.jsonl or the registry times out; sweep continues
Emitted once per run when the bash fallback is active (no timeout/gtimeout binary found)
